messages:
Elena: Hey sec/infra — prod Lambda (role=prod-secrets-unsealer) started failing on kms:Decrypt after we rotated the CMK. CloudWatch error: "User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/prod-secrets-unsealer/session is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-..."

Mike: Did you rotate the alias -> new key, or did you re-create and re-encrypt blobs? :thinking:

Elena: We created a new CMK and updated the envelope encryptor to use alias/rdw-prod-secrets. Writes (encrypt DataKey) succeed, decrypt fails at runtime in Lambda. Same error from aws-sdk Decrypt.

Sara: If encrypt works but decrypt doesn't, common culprits: key policy doesn't include the Lambda role, a grant was used then expired, or encryptionContext mismatch. Also session policies / permissions boundary on the assumed role can block kms:Decrypt.

Raj: Can you paste the CMK key policy (redact ARNs) and the Lambda role IAM policy/trust? quick check first: inside a failing Lambda can you run `aws sts get-caller-identity` and `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://...` to reproduce locally with same creds?

Elena: reproducing from an EC2 bastion while assuming the role gives same AccessDenied. Key policy (redacted):
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Sid":"EnableRoot","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"},"Action":"kms:*","Resource":"*"},
    {"Sid":"AllowSecretsSvc","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/secrets-manager-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
Lambda role IAM policy has `"kms:Decrypt"` allowed on the key ARN. Trust policy is normal `lambda.amazonaws.com` for service -> role.

Sara: Key policy is the gatekeeper. Even if the IAM role allows kms:Decrypt, the key policy must permit that principal unless the key policy uses a wildcard that defers to IAM. Right now it only explicitly allows the SM service role, not `prod-secrets-unsealer`.

Mike: Yep — two patterns: (A) update key policy to explicitly Allow the Lambda role ARN (not the assumed-role ARN; use the role ARN), or (B) add a statement in key policy that allows any principal in account to use key if their IAM policy allows it (i.e., principal = account root + Condition: kms:... but be careful). Most secure route: add role ARN to key policy.

Raj: Also confirm there's no `kms:ViaService` or `aws:SourceAccount` condition blocking this path. If you added `kms:ViaService` for secretsmanager, that could allow the SM service but not Lambda directly.

Elena: Good catch — we did add a conditional earlier for `kms:ViaService` to only allow Secrets Manager. That explains why writes via SM worked (Secrets Manager used the key) but Lambda direct decrypt fails.

security-bot: CloudTrail shows Decrypt API calls with error AccessDenied. EventID: abcd-1234 — https://console.aws.amazon.com/cloudtrail/home?region=us-east-1#/events?eventID=abcd-1234

Sara: Fix options:
- Quick patch: create a grant for the role: `aws kms create-grant --key-id <key-id> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::acct:role/prod-secrets-unsealer --operations Decrypt` — temporary and grant expires on CMK rotation if you choose.
- Recommended: update CMK key policy to add a statement allowing the role principal `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/prod-secrets-unsealer` kms:Decrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey.

Mike: If you update the key policy, test via `aws sts assume-role` + `aws kms decrypt` from bastion. Also run `aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::...:role/prod-secrets-unsealer --action-names kms:Decrypt --resource-arns arn:aws:kms:...` to see result.

Raj: Watch out for session policies/permissions boundaries. If the role is assumed with a session policy that removes kms:Decrypt, the call will still be denied. Check how Lambda is invoked — do we pass session tags/policies? Also check service-linked roles.

Elena: We're not adding session policies. Role has a permissions boundary (org-managed) that allows kms:Decrypt. But good to confirm.

Sara: Another subtle one: encryptionContext mismatch. If the DataKey was generated with an encryptionContext (e.g., {"env":"prod","service":"secrets"}) you must pass the same context to Decrypt. If you re-encrypted blobs with a different context on rotate, Decrypt will be AccessDenied.

Elena: We do pass context on encrypt/decrypt. I double-checked; same keys.

Mike: Final checklist:
1) Remove or relax `kms:ViaService` condition if you need direct Lambda decrypts, OR keep it and route decrypt through Secrets Manager.
2) Add the Lambda role principal to key policy.
3) If you prefer ephemeral fix, create a grant for the role.
4) Re-run `aws sts get-caller-identity` & `aws kms decrypt` under assumed creds to validate.
5) Check CloudTrail Decrypt events and kms key policy eval logic in logs.

Elena: I'll update the key policy to add the role and remove the `kms:ViaService` condition we added. I'll do a canary deploy to one Lambda and test. assigning to @Raj to coordinate the change and @Mike to run the simulate tests.

Raj: Got it. I'll prepare the policy diff and post in #eng-changeboard. Quick proposed stmt:
```
{
  "Sid":"AllowLambdaUnseal",
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/prod-secrets-unsealer"},
  "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
  "Resource":"*"
}
```

Mike: Also add a monitoring alert: metric filter on CloudTrail lookup for kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for prod key -> page on recurrence.

Elena: Thanks team. I'll report back after rollout. :thumbsup:

Sara: Nice root cause: overly strict `kms:ViaService` + key policy not including the role. Happens a lot after rotations where you change how keys are used. Good notes for runbook.

security-bot: Note: if you create a grant for the role and then rotate CMK with `AWS Managed` rotation off, grants persist until disabled; but if you re-create keys or use alias swap strategy, grants may need re-creation.

Elena: Patch complete in canary — decrypts now succeed. Scheduling key policy update to prod in 30m and will follow up here.
